## Outcome

Describe the observable problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Evidence

- Reproduction and regression test:
- Commands from the contribution guide's change-to-test map, with results:
- Node, adapter, backend and operating-system versions:
- Applicable lanes not run, with reason and the person accepting the gap:
- Hot-path benchmark before/after, when relevant:

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant verification lanes pass, with no unexplained skips.
- [ ] Public docs and declarations match the behavior.
- [ ] User-visible changes have an Unreleased changelog entry.
- [ ] Dependency changes include the lockfile; generated artifacts were regenerated and inspected.
- [ ] The diff and logs contain no secrets or personal deployment data.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details use the private route in SECURITY.md.

## Risk and rollback

Describe compatibility impact, failure modes and the smallest safe rollback.
